fields.description: Porto View is a waterfront collection of one- to three-bedroom apartments and four three-bedroom townhouses in Rashid Yachts & Marina. Emaar describes two connected residential buildings around a landscaped podium. The larger two-level homes place bedrooms upstairs, with living spaces and terraces below, while apartments offer a more compact way into the neighbourhood.

overview: The landscaped podium is central to Porto View’s layout, providing outdoor seating and recreation between the residential buildings. The brochure puts the emphasis on daylight, outdoor living and access to the marina neighbourhood. Water and skyline views should be assessed for the chosen home rather than assumed from the project’s promotional images.
research.locationNote: Porto View sits in Rashid Yachts & Marina, Mina Rashid, Dubai. Emaar identifies the QE2 Hotel and connections to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport. Surrounding promenade, dining and community attractions have their own access and delivery arrangements.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 1.93m. The launch fact sheet lists one-bedroom apartments from AED 1.93m, two-bedroom from AED 2.87m, three-bedroom from AED 4.07m and townhouses from AED 8.73m. Property Finder displays a different current-market headline; these historical launch prices do not establish today’s inventory.
research.paymentNote: The launch payment document sets 10% on booking, seven further 10% stages and 20% at completion. Later stages carry construction milestones. Property Finder’s main schedule agrees with 10/70/20; obtain the current contract rather than using historical dates as payment instructions.
research.handoverNote: October 2028 is the estimated completion month in the launch payment sheet and Property Finder. Verify the contractual date and current progress for the selected home.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: The fact sheet lists 53 one-bedroom, 48 two-bedroom and nine three-bedroom apartments, plus four townhouses: 114 homes in total, not remaining stock.

facts.label: Townhouse Type A.3
facts.value: TH03 places all three bedrooms upstairs. Its lower level includes kitchen/dining, living, maid’s room, laundry, storage and terrace; the primary bedroom has a walk-in wardrobe and private bathroom.

facts.label: Indoor versus total area
facts.value: TH03’s 2,718.75 sq ft total comprises 2,199.71 sq ft suite and 519.04 sq ft outdoor area. Townhouse total areas are not plot measurements.
